shorts_extract.hook: How an accidental 1976 video dub ('BA' sound + 'GA' lips = 'DA'!) proved 98% of human brains hear with their eyes.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: McGurk & MacDonald (1976 Nature, N=103) + Beauchamp et al. (2010) causal TMS disruption of posterior Superior Temporal Sulcus.
shorts_extract.twist: Why knowing the trick gives zero immunity, why lips lead sound by 120 ms, and why individual/cultural reliance rises in noise.
